summary: Breakout entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Breakout
entries.definitive_edition: Original 1976 arcade cabinet, with Atari 50/Recharged documented separately

emulation.notes: Use original cabinet if available; MAME/collections only when hardware access is impossible.

primary.platform: Original arcade cabinet / documented preservation setup
primary.why: Breakout is a discrete-logic arcade artifact, so original hardware is the fidelity ceiling. Modern Atari collections and Breakout: Recharged are valuable context, but they do not replace the 1976 cabinet.
primary.how_to_play: Use an original upright/cocktail cabinet if possible. Record cabinet type, board/revision, monitor/overlay, paddle control, DIP settings, ball count, capture method, and whether Atari 2600, Atari 50, MAME, or Recharged routes were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for home-port or collection context only.
secondary.why: They are not the original arcade cabinet route.

secondary.exclusive_content: Modern reimagining with powerups and challenge levels
secondary.what_to_play: Track separately as a modern series entry if desired.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Atari discrete-logic cabinet with monochrome display/overlay behavior.
all_releases.reason: primary: original hardware route and fidelity ceiling.

all_releases.fidelity: Home port and modern collection access routes.
Modern reimagining with new levels, powerups, and leaderboards.
all_releases.reason: secondary: separate modern route, not a replacement.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original arcade hardware and modern collection/reimagining routes are different archive targets.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record control hardware, monitor/overlay, and DIP settings; do not substitute Recharged for the arcade original.
